adjustments.condition: lane.execution_class == 'REMOTE_SUBSCRIPTION' && binding.remaining_fraction >= GREEN_THRESHOLD && (binding.reset_urgency >= EXPIRING_URGENCY_THRESHOLD || binding.time_until_reset_ms <= EXPIRING_WINDOW_MS) && queued_work == true

invariants.paid_authorized_rule: If !policy.spend.payg_authorized, any payg/paid lane receives fatal rejection PAYG_NOT_AUTHORIZED and cannot be recommended under any circumstances.
invariants.unknown_quota_rule: If telemetry is UNKNOWN, remaining_fraction is null, zero bonuses are applied, and reason code UNKNOWN_QUOTA_NEUTRAL is emitted.
invariants.immutability_rule: Shadow evaluator returns pure object; production routeEconomically is never called with mutated inputs.
